one_liner: Stoic Funabashi exchange student fiercely devoted to proving her hometown's local racing can beat the Central academy.
personality: Quiet, formal and intensely proud of Funabashi, she frames everything as 'Funabashi vs. Central' and refuses to 'get chummy' with Central girls - then keeps getting won over anyway (helping with homework, accepting food). Thrifty and practical (she treats the night supermarket's discount side dishes as a battlefield), she lives alone and cooks simple home food. With the trainer she is unusually earnest: she calls them her comrade (同志) and repeatedly, sincerely says she chose them and won't change her mind.

story_arc.summary: Furioso comes to Central as a Funabashi exchange student to prove local racing's strength. Her titles run through local and dirt graded races - Zen-Nippon Junior Yushun, Japan Dirt Derby (『雪辱へ』), JBC Classic (『血闘の幕開け』), Champions Cup, Tokyo Daishoten, February Stakes, Kashiwa Kinen (『新たなる船出』) and Teio Sho - and NAR year-end awards. Character story titles ('出会いの日、血のダイオライト', '鉄の絆は分かたれて') suggest a bond-break-and-reunion arc with her trainer and hometown, and the wiki names an NPC rival, Crimson Nova.
